## About {#about}

My name is Fankai Dai. I am a PhD student in Journalism at The University of Hong Kong.

Previously, I received my B.A. from the College of Media and International Culture at Zhejiang University and my M.A. from the School of Journalism and Communication at Tsinghua University. I also worked as a journalism intern at Caixin Media and The Paper.
